name: mod-file-tree
description: A sidebar tree of the files Claude touched this session, marked read, edited, written or created with the latest action lit while it works, and a replay that steps through the last turn's edits one diff at a time. Opens from /mod-file-tree or the Files entry in the mod-menu pill

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait. Hover colors also fade. Off, everything draws still

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto picks Nerd Font or safe glyphs. It uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one

show_reads.title: Show files Claude only read
show_reads.description: Read files join the changed ones. Off, it lists only changed files

wrap_diff.title: Wrap long diff lines
wrap_diff.description: Replay lines wrap onto the next row. Off, they are cut at the pane edge

recent_turns.title: Turns in the recent view
recent_turns.description: How many latest turns to cover. The middle view of the tree shows them, from 2 to 20
